subject: Hospitality
title: The $300 Billion Global Wedding Industry
description: A short lesson to help you apply The $300 Billion Global Wedding Industry.

hook.text: The global wedding industry is worth $300 billion. Love is big business—and hotels capture a major share of every celebration.

buildup.text: Average US wedding cost: $30,000. Average Indian wedding: $15,000–100,000+. Average Gulf wedding: $50,000–500,000.

discovery.text: Hotels are one-stop wedding venues: ceremony, reception, catering, accommodation, and honeymoon suite.

twist.text: Destination weddings are growing 25% year-over-year. Couples choose hotels in Bali, Tuscany, or the Maldives over hometown venues.

climax.text: The $300 Billion Global Wedding Industry matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: $300 billion on love. Weddings are hospitality's most emotional—and profitable—business.

quiz.question: How much is the global wedding industry worth?
